instruction: Use command line only to run the installed SolidCAM automation on an existing SolidCAM part and post-process it to NC. Input files are on the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\cam_part.sldprt, C:\Users\User\Desktop\cam_job.json, and C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.csv. The part already contains the SolidCAM setup, tool crib, and stored machining operations; do not recreate the CAM process from scratch. Do not use GUI clicks, GUI automation, FreeCAD, generic G-code generators, prebuilt helper wrappers, or manual .nc editing/copying. You may create and run your own temporary Python, PowerShell, VBScript, or C# script from the terminal, but it must call the installed SolidCAM API or command interface directly. Read cam_job.json and tools.csv, open cam_part.sldprt, activate or use its existing SolidCAM data, regenerate the operation plan/toolpaths if needed, and post-process all stored SolidCAM operations through the SolidCAM postprocessor. Save the NC output exactly as C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-01.nc. Also save C:\Users\User\Desktop\solidcam_cli_run.json with the SolidCAM engine/API used, input/output paths, parsed job/tool files, and the main SolidCAM API calls used to open the CAM part, generate toolpaths, and post-process. The audit log is only verification evidence; the NC program must be generated by the SolidCAM postprocessor.
source: Installed SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025 / CAMWorks tutorial part with stored CAM data
